h1: Custom Etched Barware for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom etched barware in bulk for corporate gifts, events, and promotions. Free quotes at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Etched barware offers a permanent, upscale look that screen printing or foil stamping cannot match. The frosted design is created by removing a thin layer of glass, leaving a mark that will never fade, peel, or wash off. This makes etched glasses, decanters, and wine bottles ideal for executive gifts, wedding favors, or high-end promotional events where a refined appearance matters. Choose from rocks glasses, pint glasses, or stemware, and add your logo or monogram with crisp detail.
heroAltText: Custom etched barware featuring a frosted logo on a set of rocks glasses and a decanter
